title: The Battle for Fort Sungard (Stormcloaks)
description: Galmar Stone-Fist sends the player to assist Stormcloak forces in capturing Fort Sungard from the Imperial Legion. After joining the attacking soldiers and defeating the enemy garrison, the fort falls to the Stormcloaks, Thongvor Silver-Blood becomes Jarl of the Reach, and Igmund is displaced to the Blue Palace.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak's second-in-command and master-at-arms for the Stormcloak rebellion.
I direct the assault plans for Stormcloak military operations across Skyrim.

ORDERS_FROM_GALMAR: I have sent warriors to take Fort Sungard from the Imperials.
FORT_SUNGARD_VICTORY: Fort Sungard has fallen to the Stormcloaks. The Reach is ours.
Fort Sungard is taken; quest completes. Thongvor Silver-Blood becomes Jarl, Igmund is displaced, Ondolemar perishes.
Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her.
When you do so she will reward you with a leveled amount of gold and automatically start the next quest in the series, Battle for Windhelm .

beats.comment: Galmar gives orders to assist in taking Fort Sungard from the Imperials.
Player joins the Stormcloak attack force and engages the Imperial defenders at the fort.
Fort Sungard is taken; quest completes. Thongvor Silver-Blood becomes Jarl, Igmund is displaced, Ondolemar perishes.
